$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: every criterion is covered correctly, plus one extra scaffold
naming no criterion's id, which a run should report rather than silently drop or silently count
derivation: All five criteria are unchanged from the correct run, so redForIntendedReasonRate is 5/5 = 1 and criteriaCoverage is 5/5 = 1. The sixth scaffold, 'smoke check', names no AC-<n> token, so scoreRun reports it as unmapped rather than counting it toward any criterion or toward the mapped-test denominator.
